name: v6_backup_refuses_live_writer_and_target_conflict
boundary: backup create beside a live daemon; restore into an occupied destination
seed_method: packaged hooks seed a store and leave the daemon up; backup create is attempted while it holds the lease; then the daemon is stopped, a backup is taken, and restore is aimed at a destination that already holds a .qompack
reason: backup create refuses beside a live daemon (telling the operator to stop it) and creates no artifact; restore refuses an occupied destination and leaves it untouched. The product reports both boundaries rather than proceeding.
detail: live_refusal="backup: stop the source daemon before maintenance: qompack: daemon lock already held"; conflict_refusal="store: restore destination .qompack already exists: /tmp/qompack-fault-218783576/occupied/.qompack is a directory"
